caseName: Graham v. U.S. Dist. Court for the Middle Dist. of Fla.
caseNameFull: Steven Anthony GRAHAM v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR the MIDDLE DISTRICT OF FLORIDA.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
